# TaxSense AI

> TaxSense AI is an AI income-tax copilot for India, built by MNB Research (Abrobot Technologies Private Limited, Faridabad, Haryana, India). Users describe how they earn; TaxSense computes tax under both the old and new regimes, shows every line of the working, finds missed deductions, picks the ITR form and produces a filing-ready summary. It imports Form 16 and AIS, runs 280+ automated checks and offers 25+ calculators for salaried people, businesses, investors and tax professionals. Users' numbers are never used to train AI models. Free to start, no signup needed.
